card.name: Autonomous Action Unit
card.officialText: Pay 1500 LP, then target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your field in Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

behavior: activation only from active physical representative hand in open Main Phase
1500 LP paid at activation and never refunded on negation/invalid target/no space
target must be eligible monster in opponent team's shared GY
opponent inactive partner physical owner is preserved
resolution summons face-up Attack under activating team and writes equippedTo
Equip leaving field by destruction, bounce to hand or banish destroys equipped monster
equipped monster leaving field sends Equip Spell to GY and clears link
destruction/leave destination for target follows physical card owner team, not current controller
activationId replay protection persisted through JSON
inventory snapshot conservation and immutable inputs

scenarios: Equip return to physical owner hand after rotation

limitations: Adapter ainda não está registrado no resolver v9 nem no catálogo; não certifica a carta e não a torna jogável em produção.
Suíte usa TagDuel temporário/SQLite ausente; não valida gateway ou guild Discord real.
Deck 20–30 é regra de construção; o adaptador não trunca Deck em duelo e preserva mãos acima de seis até End Phase.
